query_normalized: predicting molecular permeability coefficients using graph neural networks and publicly available datasets chemistry
rationale: The paper focuses on the general architectural challenge of handling homophily and heterophily in Graph Neural Networks across generic real-world datasets, without addressing the specific domain of molecular permeability, chemistry, or the use of publicly available chemical datasets.
